historic_survey.survey: Progressive Era & Early Revival Styles Historic Context Statement (2023)
historic_survey.note: The Bank of California built 1906-1908 to designs by Bliss & Faville — a three-storey Classical temple with a large colonnade and Corinthian ornamentation, and a prime example of the Classical Revival style.

historic_survey.survey: Modern & Postmodern Architectural Styles Historic Context Statement (2024)
historic_survey.note: The Bank of California, designed by Bliss & Faville, the historic building to which a Modernist office tower was added in the 1960s.
